context: A teacher discusses an art-restoration paper
purpose: Teach: 唱える/全域/山頂/代償/盛況/訳者/塗料/無謀

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、文化財保護を唱える運動、よくまとめましたね。
lines.en: Your paper on the heritage-protection movement was really well put together.
lines.style: Warm, observant. Opens with genuine appreciation. Measured pace. Teacher-to-student but not performing authority—just noticing good work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指定対象は全域に広がりつつあります。
lines.en: Yes. The designations keep expanding to new regions.
lines.style: Steady, a bit formal. Small pause before the second sentence—he's thinking, not just reciting. Slight pride in having done the research thoroughly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 山頂の社寺、修復、丁寧に取材されましたね。
lines.en: The mountaintop shrines and their restoration work—you covered that really thoughtfully.
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly. Genuine interest in the specifics. Slow enough to show she's picturing his research. Noticing not just effort but precision.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 保護の代償、経済的側面も論じました。
lines.en: I also discussed the trade-offs—the economic side of preservation.
lines.style: Slight hesitation before 'also'—checking if this was the right angle to include. Quiet conviction that it mattered. Not apologetic, but testing whether she agrees it was necessary.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 発表会、盛況でしたね。外国人来訪者、訳者通訳でフォローされていました。
lines.en: The presentation itself went really well. The foreign visitors could follow it through the interpreters.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself. A small smile in the voice—pleased that the work reached people. Warm, not performative. The kind of thing a teacher remembers because it mattered.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 修復用の塗料、無謀な薬剤使用、禁止されているそうですね。
lines.en: I read that restoration paints with those harmful chemicals are actually prohibited now.
lines.style: Quick, attentive. A real question underneath—he's connecting dots, not just listing facts. Light curiosity, like he's thinking out loud but checking if she knew that too.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. A small exhale of approval. Not closing the door, but offering him space to move forward. Teacher's shorthand for 'you're thinking in the right direction.'
